# Greg Gardner Motors Ltd.

> Greg Gardner Motors Ltd. is a  dealership in Squamish. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/greg-gardner-motors-ltd-mirror/used/): 146 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/greg-gardner-motors-ltd-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability
